name: Uematsu Rikako
source:
Occupation: Priestess
Stay as: Dweller

Rikako is the head of the Uematsu household, one of the chief families in Fujiyoshi Village.

As a priestess, she recounts the legends and traditions of Fujiyoshi.

[Taken from the official art book included with the [url=/r65525]Day One Edition[/url].]
